legal_hero_derivation.generic: Dorinthea has no intrinsic AA hit/draw/token trigger; weapon-specific ability cannot affect these AA attacks.
legal_hero_derivation.earth: Oldhim Essence of Earth/Ice permits Earth and Generic cards. No defense reaction ability is activated.
legal_hero_derivation.lightning: Lexi Essence of Ice/Lightning permits Lightning and Generic cards. No hero ability/Arsenal flip is activated.

rules.interpretation: A when-hit effect creates a triggered layer, with creation of its token deferred to layer resolution; it must be present before next priority.
Positive hit-event damage triggers; full prevention/no damage does not. Damage-step priority occurs before resolution of pending layers. Printed no-goagain attacks do not refund AP.

source_predicted_holds.evidence: OnHit directly invokes FaBRunSourceMacro Hit; all12 actual compiled Hit callbacks call token helper synchronously. Token helper AddArena creates immediately and does not AddStack. No bounded queue exception names these12. Native before-proof required; no executed bug claim.
FaBELEPlayed destroys every Embodiment of Lightning and tags new AA with GO_AGAIN directly. Correct-rule token consumer case must retain queued trigger timing, even if current native code does not.
